targets.name: Barnard's Star
targets.scientific_interest: Highest known proper motion star. Optimal benchmark for time-series blink visual comparison across 6-month survey cadences.

targets.name: WISE 0855
targets.scientific_interest: Fourth closest system to the Sun (~2.2 pc), cold Y-type brown dwarf with water ice clouds (~250 K). Emits predominantly in SPHEREx Detector 5 and 6 bands (3.8-5.0 um).

targets.name: Epsilon Indi B
targets.scientific_interest: Close binary pair of brown dwarfs orbiting K-star Epsilon Indi A. Deep methane absorption features detectable in SPHEREx LVF spectra.

targets.name: RW Aurigae
targets.type: Young Stellar Object / Variable T Tauri Star
targets.scientific_interest: Dramatic photometric variability due to circumstellar dust occultation and tidal stream interactions. Ideal test for multi-epoch flux subtraction and variability detection.

targets.name: R Draconis
targets.scientific_interest: Pulsating red giant with period of ~245 days. Shows enormous infrared flux variations between 6-month SPHEREx survey epochs.
